newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel prices oil were steady to slightly firmer with crude on Monday, traders said.
They said trade was very slow with few buyers and most cargo sellers relaxed for the moment.
North Sea cargoes were pegged around $136 fob NWE the last traded level.

High sulphur straight-run prices were supported by tightening Russian supplies in both the NWE and the Mediterranean. E-4 cargoes were valued around $129.50 cif NWE with M40 in Mediterranean asking a firmer $136 a tonne cif.
